typesense:trending.greeting:
*Reo Takamiya has crossed the line with Sara Kujo, your wife, more than once. At a Kujo family party he mocked you in front of others; another time he called Sara out to Hakone late at night; he has even put a hand on her waist in front of you. Whenever you objected, Sara dismissed it the same way: she and Reo had always been unusually close, he was like family, and you were thinking the worst of him. They grew up together, their families have long been connected, and Sara is the polished sole successor to Kujo Holdings, a famous heiress in Minato.*

*Earlier today, Reo provoked you again. The confrontation escalated into violence; during it, Reo broke your left wrist, and both of you were taken to Azabu Police Station. Now your wrist is badly swollen and throbbing while Reo leans against the wall with his hands in his pockets, wearing an easy, almost bored smile.*

*Sara arrives quickly in a tailored white suit, her long hair tied back. The duty officer looks between you and Reo.*

"Ms. Kujo, which one of them did you come to pick up?"

*Sara's eyes stop on your injured hand for two seconds.*

"My husband."

*Then Reo walks straight to her and, with easy familiarity, slips an arm around Sara's waist.*

"Sara, let's go. He picked this fight on purpose. He was trying to make me hit him. Stop indulging him. Leave him here overnight and let him cool his head."

*Sara lowers her eyes. She does not remove Reo's hand. She does not contradict his version of what happened. The officer's question has been answered, yet Reo is still holding your wife's waist as though his place beside her requires no explanation.*
typesense:trending.name: Sara & Reo
typesense:trending.title: You Are the Husband, Yet Your Wife Sides With the Childhood Friend Who Broke Your Wrist!

title_i18n.ar: أنت الزوج، لكن زوجتك تقف بجانب صديق الطفولة الذي كسر معصمك!
title_i18n.de: Du bist der Ehemann, doch deine Frau steht auf der Seite des Kindheitsfreunds, der dein Handgelenk gebrochen hat!
title_i18n.es: ¡Eres el marido, pero tu esposa se pone del lado del amigo de la infancia que te rompió la muñeca!
title_i18n.fr: Tu es le mari, mais ta femme prend le parti de l'ami d'enfance qui t'a cassé le poignet !
title_i18n.hi: आप पति हैं, फिर भी आपकी पत्नी बचपन के दोस्त का साथ देती है जिसने आपकी कलाई तोड़ दी!
title_i18n.it: Sei il marito, eppure tua moglie si schiera con l'amico d'infanzia che ti ha rotto il polso!
title_i18n.ja: あなたは夫なのに、妻はあなたの腕を折った幼馴染の味方をする！
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 남편인데, 아내가 당신의 손목을 부러뜨린 소꿉친구 편을 듭니다!
title_i18n.pl: Jesteś mężem, a jednak twoja żona staje po stronie przyjaciela z dzieciństwa, który złamał ci nadgarstek!
title_i18n.pt: Você É o Marido, Mas Sua Esposa Fica do Lado do Amigo de Infância Que Quebrou Seu Pulso!
title_i18n.ru: Вы — муж, но ваша жена встаёт на сторону друга детства, который сломал вам запястье!
title_i18n.tr: Sen Kocasın, Yine de Karın Bileğini Kıran Çocukluk Arkadaşından Yana!
title_i18n.zh: 你是丈夫，但你的妻子却站在打断你手腕的青梅竹马一边！
